US military AI error nearly triggered war with China, reports say

Artificial intelligence used by the US military generated a false intelligence report that nearly led to a war with China, according to multiple reports. The AI's error suggested a potential attack on Chinese vessels, prompting the US military to prepare for a response. The incident, which occurred during the Iran war, was reportedly averted at the last moment when the falsity of the AI's intelligence was discovered. The reports highlight the potential dangers of over-reliance on AI for critical military decisions.
